tools.explanation: Older electromechanical-tool headings and newer hand-tool headings use different allocations; combined native subtotals agree. No historic HS edition is imputed.

clays_minerals.explanation: Geostat source tables allocate matching amounts between kaolin/clay and mineral headings differently. Exact cause is not declared; do not join or recode the native series.

knitted_fabrics.explanation: Legacy and newer knitted-fabric headings have different native subdivisions; combined source subtotals agree. No harmonization is inferred.

leather.explanation: Legacy and newer leather headings have different native subdivisions; combined source subtotals agree. WCO documents renumbering across HS revisions.

mixed_goods_gases.explanation: Petroleum-gas and publisher-defined Mixed goods subtotals are allocated differently between the HS4/HS6 sources in 2015-2019. Preserve the original labels and withhold prefix equivalence; no commodity identity is guessed.
